schemes._ddt_note: 2nd order implicit - same as app profiles
schemes._grad_note: limiter=1 (less restrictive than app standard's 0.5) - better gradient preservation for LES
schemes._div_note: 2nd order upwind - LOWER diffusion than app standard's limitedLinearV. Critical for LES to preserve turbulent structures. Requires good mesh quality.
schemes._laplacian_note: Limited correction (0.5) for stability on non-orthogonal cells. App 'accurate' uses full 'corrected'.
schemes._snGrad_note: Matches laplacian limiting for consistency. More stable than full 'corrected'.
schemes._scheme_summary: These schemes are between app 'standard' (stable/diffusive) and 'accurate' (low-diffusion). Optimized for LES on real aortic geometries with some mesh non-orthogonality.
